only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~163% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.162), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.5054. Series context: trend strength 0.979 and seasonal strength 0.4215; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.162); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.647.
